OutputBrief.reader_goal: Decide whether the forecast overrun is absorbed centrally or offset by scope reduction.
decisions_sought: Approve the additional integration spend, or mandate an offsetting scope reduction

StorylinePlan.governing_message: Integration spending is within budget on actuals but the forecast is not, and the gap is not covered by synergies landing this year.
StorylinePlan.executive_takeaway: On an actual-cost basis the programme remains inside its approved envelope. The current forecast does not, and the shortfall is concentrated in a small number of one-time items. Synergy realisation is running behind the profile that was assumed when the budget was set, so the gap cannot be expected to close itself.
StorylinePlan.situation: The integration budget was approved at signing on a profile that assumed synergies landing through the year.
StorylinePlan.complication: Forecast costs have risen while synergy realisation has run behind the assumed profile.
StorylinePlan.question: Is the overrun absorbed centrally, or offset by reducing scope?
supporting_arguments: Actual spend is inside budget; the exposure is entirely in the forecast.
The forecast increase is concentrated in a small number of one-time items rather than spread across the programme.
Synergy realisation is behind the profile the budget assumed, so it will not close the gap.
StorylinePlan.closing_ask: Confirm the funding route for the forecast overrun.
